title: Narrow the owner's storage scope with session tags (security review finding 4)
description: The owner's DynamoDB scope is <tenant>#* on the Messaging table, which includes the organization record (awsExternalId, cross-account role, memberships), the roster (bots, workers with token hashes), channels, computers and tasks. Narrowing the session policy does not fit the 2048-character STS limit (2018 today; three statements need 2877). Fix: session tags (tenant, bot, channel, turn) plus a static policy on the scoped role using ${aws:PrincipalTag/...}, which also removes the policy-size headroom problem. Needs sts:TagSession in the role trust, starter change and the computer record moved out of the roster key (the owner updates it there and IAM cannot restrict by sort key). Read-only org and budget_rollup families, write families for turn, channel, computer actions, vendor ledger and the mailbox.
right_now_summary: The team is designing session-tagged IAM policies to narrow owner access and move computer records out of the roster.
